contents.entry: Purpose and how to read a disposition
Method: how each finding was verified
Findings the review missed, F27 onward
Decisions only the owner can make

purpose.s: This volume answers, for every finding, whether it holds, where the evidence is, and which anchor of the book now resolves it.

accepted means the finding holds as stated; accepted-partial means it holds but part of the claim or its severity is wrong, and the note says which part; rejected and superseded are available and unused, because every review finding reproduced at the pinned commit; new marks a defect the review missed.
A resolution pointer names the authoritative anchor; the book states each rule once there and every other volume cites it.

Every proof that a resolution works at runtime is not-run: this is design work and nothing is built; the only executed proofs are the reproductions of the defects (probes P01 to P07 and the extra probes) and the book checks.

method.s: Each finding was re-derived from the book at fb7135ef89e819b91249ac890ebbffcd52c4adea by reading the cited lines and the volumes around them, not from the review text.

Probes P01 to P07 were re-run with python3, jsonschema 4.26.0 and SQLite 3.45.1 against the book schemas; every producer example and synthetic producer record was validated against every consumer schema (19 synthetic records, 10 book examples).
External facts (GitHub REST, branch protection, Jenkins queue, ntfy iOS delivery, Kaniko upstream and forks, the local claude --help) were checked on 2026-10-15 and are named in sources.

tally.s: All 26 review findings hold at the pinned commit: 21 as stated and 5 in part (F07 severity, F16, F17, F21 and F24 scope); none is rejected or superseded, because no commit landed after the pin.
The verification found 42 further defects (F27 to F68), 20 of them blocker or high.

finding.title: Seat permissions do not establish the promised security boundary
finding.evidence: socket mode 0600, same user only: every seat runs as the owner uid
Put has no authorization step and N-01 emits no 403
rule text of the relay clause (the cited :151 is its open tag)
seat env excludes COQ_SEAT; nothing ever sets it, yet N-29 and N-32 trust it
finding.verdict: The book is weaker than the review states: no API authorizes anything, seats can read other seats' tokens, and every credential belongs to one user. Fix: separate Unix users per principal, SO_PEERCRED on the store socket, role and permitted kinds derived on the server, 403 record.refused. Containers deferred. WSL interop off is an owner decision.
finding.proof: runtime proof lands with the build ticket cut from the resolution anchor

finding.title: Global idempotency keys collide between different operations
finding.evidence: one key per effect, but six effects of one run share the dispatch id
a second Put returns the first commit with no payload comparison
seat.bundle keyed by the dispatch id that N-14 and N-15 also use
finding.verdict: Probe P04 reproduced and widened: of six prescribed keys only one commits. Fix: node/operation/subject/r<revision> keys whose node segment must equal the caller, request hash stored, 409 idempotency_mismatch before any effect.
finding.proof: runtime proof lands with the build ticket cut from the resolution anchor

finding.title: The producer and consumer schemas cannot carry the same dispatch
finding.evidence: deadline, flat lease key, integer token, boolean build_mode
deadline_at, nested lease with a string token, repo, repo_sha, object build_mode
a third build_mode shape
the owner-read dispatch example fails N-13 and N-14
finding.verdict: Probes P01 and P02 reproduced. Wider than stated: CR spec dispatches and gate dispatches fail their own producer schema. Fix: one dispatch_body def that every producer and consumer references, with examples for every phase checked by C23.
finding.proof: runtime proof lands with the build ticket cut from the resolution anchor

finding.title: Atomic transactions are promised but absent from the store API contract
finding.evidence: record_put refuses an entities array
one transaction under one idempotency key, with no API that writes it
admission needs several keys in one transaction
finding.verdict: Probe P03 reproduced. No API writes node-owned tables at all. Fix: Store.Commit, one transaction with preconditions, entity CAS, owner-registered statements, records and outbox effects, all or nothing.
finding.proof: runtime proof lands with the build ticket cut from the resolution anchor

finding.title: Lease grant, dispatch, hold and revoke rules disagree
finding.evidence: grant sets a holder
dispatch selects only leases with an empty holder
hold refuses every claim, so the watcher exits 3 and is never restarted
generation defined three ways (also N-02:92, state-store.xml:108)
finding.verdict: Accepted with extensions: system lease keys fail the key pattern and fencing by (ticket, attempt) is ambiguous. Fix: one lease state machine with classes, GrantDispatch atomic with the dispatch, generation only on grant, hold gating only seat grants and work-class leases.
finding.proof: runtime proof lands with the build ticket cut from the resolution anchor

finding.title: Bootstrap and resume gates remain contradictory
finding.evidence: step 0 triggers before GOFACTORY while DESIGN.md:29 forbids any build before it
a USERGO before step 7 proofs is accepted
the first arm64 controller image is built by the amd64 host leg alone
finding.verdict: Nuance: ci/image/build.sh already builds multi-arch with qemu; the contradiction is in N-22 prose and runbook R1. Fix: bootstrap state machine B0 to B8; foundation work may precede GOFACTORY; runtime only after the GOFACTORY ruling; USERGO only at B7.
finding.proof: runtime proof lands with the build ticket cut from the resolution anchor

finding.title: The reuse inventory overstates the existing protobuf API
finding.evidence: seven RPCs kept whole
the same false list, not cited by the review
finding.verdict: The defect is real but its impact is medium: N-01 already defines a new Store service. The real proto has Executor{Run, Health} and Scheduler{Health, Status, Reload, Drain, Retry} and nothing streams. Both texts are corrected.

finding.title: Forge credentials and gate authority are inconsistent

finding.title: The poll plan misses required endpoints and same-head transitions
finding.evidence: no per-PR GET, yet the snapshot schema requires mergeable

finding.verdict: Stronger than stated. Fix: per-PR GET, paginated files, conditional status reads every poll, N-08 runs every tick and escalates by age.

finding.title: Strict branch protection has no deterministic stale-base recovery
finding.evidence: the same merge is retried three times on an unchanged head
claims N-09 handles a clean rebase; it has no such step
finding.verdict: Fix: N-09 branches on mergeable_state; behind uses update-branch with expected_head_sha and a fresh gate.

finding.title: Launcher recovery does not match its process and file lifecycle
finding.evidence: KillMode=mixed kills every seat on a service restart

kill grace 2 s here, 30 s at N-15:147, 10 s at failure-cases.xml:36
finding.verdict: Stronger than stated. Fix: one transient systemd unit per run outside the service cgroup, a run state entity, partial result renamed and sealed, one kill authority, kill grace 30 s.

finding.title: Backup, sequence and restore semantics are not retention-safe
finding.evidence: seq never reused, while :157 makes seq the rowid

finding.title: Cleanup and image retention need reference and filesystem safety

owner-decisions.decision: Confirm one Raspberry Pi of the cluster is free for the outside probe (F15); until then the probe is designed and its proof is not-run.
Create the coq-gate GitHub App and record its app_id (F08); the required check names it.
Turn WSL interop off and mount Windows drives with umask 077 on the host (F01); both change how the owner uses the host.

Bootstrap merge path (F52): the default is that N-09 merges under hold only PRs of the current bootstrap step with a green gate and review.passed; the alternative is an owner break-glass merge for each.
Accept the Kaniko pin to the osscontainertools fork v1.28.5 by digest, with BuildKit rootless as the fallback (F25).
GOFACTORY and USERGO remain the owner's words; nothing in this volume grants or implies either.

many-agents.s: One finding id names one defect; a later reviewer appends new ids after the highest and never renumbers, so two authors adding findings at once collide only on the next id, which C09 and C29 refuse.
